full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric photograph shows an empty wooden boat moored beside a weathered waterside house in thick morning mist. The boat lies diagonally across the lower foreground, its narrow bow pointing right and a worn blue stripe just visible along the outside hull. The open interior reveals cross seats and pale scuffed wood. Dark still water surrounds it, with almost no visible reflection. Behind the boat, a short stone landing rises to a partly open wooden doorway on the right. A stained tan plaster wall, dark roof edge and recessed upper window show the age of the building. Dense green shrubs and small white and red flowers cluster beside the entrance; a larger tree spreads soft leaves across the left half. Beyond the tree, the waterway and opposite distance vanish into pale gray mist. The chosen viewpoint is close and level with the bank, making the simple boat and doorway feel linked by a narrow strip of stone. Light is broad and diffuse, entering from the foggy left and touching the boat rim, flowers and worn wall while keeping the doorway nearly black. Color remains muted: blue-green water, olive foliage, weathered brown wood, tan plaster and tiny floral accents. Moisture and haze soften distant edges, while near wood grain, stone roughness and leaves stay delicately visible. No person or readable sign appears. The overall composition is quiet and slightly mysterious, balancing a diagonal foreground vessel against a dark opening and dissolving mist.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形氛围照片呈现一只空木船停在斑驳水边房屋旁，四周是浓厚晨雾。船斜卧下方前景，窄船首指向右边，船壳外侧仅隐约可见一道磨旧蓝线。敞开的船内露出横座和浅色磨损木板。深色静水围住它，几乎看不到倒影。船后，一处短石台升向右侧半开的木门。污迹斑斑的棕褐灰泥墙、深色屋檐和内凹的上层窗显出房子的年代。浓密绿灌木和细小白、红花聚在入口旁；一棵较大树把柔软叶子伸满左半部。树后，水道和对岸远处消失在浅灰雾中。视点贴近且与岸边平视，让简单小船和门口被一窄条石地连接。光从雾蒙蒙的左侧宽阔漫射，轻触船沿、花和磨旧墙面，却让门洞近乎黑色。色彩受限：蓝绿色水面、橄榄叶、旧棕木、棕褐灰泥与少量花朵重音。湿气和薄雾柔化远处边缘，近处木纹、石面粗糙度与叶子仍细腻可辨。画面无人或可读标识。整体构图安静且略带神秘，以前景斜向小船平衡深色开口和逐渐消散的雾。
style_prompt_en: An atmospheric color-photography treatment uses low saturation, dense mist and gentle cool-to-warm material contrast. Blue-green and olive shadows dominate, with weathered tan and muted brown providing quiet weight and a few tiny color accents punctuating the stillness. Diffuse light from one pale side lifts near edges while recesses remain deep and soft. Moist air dissolves the far field into gray, yet close surfaces retain delicate grain, roughness and damp texture. A diagonal low form crosses a mostly horizontal and vertical structure, creating restrained tension without visual clutter. The composition holds crisp near detail against empty hazy distance, producing a secluded, contemplative mood.
style_prompt_zh: 氛围感彩色摄影处理使用低饱和度、浓雾与温和的冷暖材料对比。蓝绿和橄榄色阴影占主导，磨旧棕褐与低调棕色提供安静重量，几处细小彩色重音点亮静止感。一侧浅淡漫射光提亮近处边缘，凹处仍深而柔软。潮湿空气把远场溶成灰色，近处表面却保留细腻颗粒、粗糙度与湿润肌理。一道低矮斜形穿过大体水平和竖向的结构，在不拥挤的画面里制造克制张力。构图让清晰近景细节对照空旷雾远处，形成隐居、沉思的气氛。
theme_en: An empty wooden boat beside a weathered waterside house in morning mist
theme_zh: 晨雾中，一只空木船停在斑驳水边房屋旁
name: Toshio Shibata
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
